scope: Add African art to Atrium: museum-published photogrammetry scans of African objects (Sub-Saharan, Sahel/Tuareg, Ethiopian), CC0 / CC BY / CC BY-SA only, fetched from licensed archive copies (Zenodo 3D Big Data Space, Objaverse 1.0) because Sketchfab downloads require an API token. Ancient Egyptian antiquities were left out of scope for this batch.
